summary:
Qualified Chartered Accountant with experience in Statutory Audit at a Big 4 firm, involved in key audit procedures including
Walkthroughs Test of Controls (TOC), and Test of Details (TOD). Hands-on exposure to preliminary engagement activities, risk
assessment, and audit documentation while supporting end-to-end audit processes. Seeking to further build expertise in assurance,
financial reporting, and statutory audit engagements in a professional environment.

bullets: Client Assignment: Mahindra Steel Service Centre Limited

Participated in RAPD meetings and audit planning discussions, gaining an understanding of the client’s business processes, Key risk areas, and internal control framework related to procurement, payroll processing, and expense management.

Assisted in determining overall materiality and performance materiality for the audit engagement based on relevant financial benchmarks, supporting the audit planning process and ensuring that audit procedures were designed in line with the materiality thresholds and risk assessment.
Assisted in the statutory audit of a listed entity as part of a Big 4 engagement team, primarily covering key business cycles including Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Payroll, and Employee Expenses.

Performed Walkthrough (WT) procedures for P2P, Payroll, and Expenses cycles to document end-to-end process flow, identify key controls, and evaluate the design and implementation of internal controls.

Executed Test of Controls (TOC) over critical controls within the P2P and payroll processes, including approval controls, segregation of duties, and system-based validations to assess their operating effectiveness.

Conducted Test of Details (TOD) by verifying supporting documentation such as vendor invoices, purchase orders, payroll records, and employee expense claims to validate the accuracy, completeness, and authorization of transactions.

Prepared and maintained audit documentation and working papers in accordance with firm methodology and auditing standards, while coordinating with client teams to obtain required schedules, reconciliations, and supporting evidence.

Performed external confirmation procedures as part of substantive audit testing by preparing and sending balance confirmations to third parties (such as vendors and other stakeholders), tracking responses, performing follow-ups for non-responses, and carrying out alternative audit procedures to validate the completeness and accuracy of reported balances.

Performed Planning Analytical Review (AR) by analyzing key financial statement line items and ratios, comparing current year figures with prior periods and budgets to identify unusual fluctuations and potential risk areas, supporting the audit team in focusing on significant accounts during the planning phase.

Assisted in statutory audit engagements across multiple industries including hospitality, real estate, pharmaceuticals , manufacturing, and banking, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting and auditing standards.

Performed vouching of expenses and revenue transactions, ledger scrutiny, and verification of supporting documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and validity of financial records. Along with verification of opening balances and reconciliations with prior year audited financial statements to ensure correctness and continuity in financial reporting.
Conducted banking audit procedures, including review of KYC documentation and compliance with RBI guidelines, verification of customer records, and checking adherence to regulatory norms.
Verified fixed assets register and depreciation calculations in accordance with Schedule II of the Companies Act, 2013, including review of additions, disposals, and capitalization policies.
Conducted Tax Audits under Section 44AB of the Income-tax Act, 1961 and prepared Forms 3CA/3CB and 3CD, along with filing of Income Tax Returns and TDS returns for individuals and business entities.

Computed Advance Tax liabilities, Capital Gains (including Section 50) and advised clients on TDS applicability, disallowances under Section 40A(3), adjustments under Section 43A, and deductions under Chapter VI-A.
Handled GST compliance and return filings including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-9 under the Goods and Services Tax framework, ensuring accurate reporting and regulatory compliance.

Performed GST reconciliations with books of accounts and GSTR-2B, resolved vendor discrepancies, and provided advisory on ITC eligibility (Sec 16), blocked credit (Sec 17(5)), Reverse Charge Mechanism, and determination of time and place of supply.
